operational.name: Video production
operational.description: Creative briefs, storyboards and shots in your organization's Onto, linked to your products.

demo.name: Video production
demo.description: Explore a sample brief, storyboard and shots. Nothing is saved.

presentation.outcome: Turn a creative brief into storyboards and shots linked to your products, and see which shots still wait on a visual reference.
steps: Write who a video is for, the one message, what it may claim and the call to action, and link it to the products it promotes.
Plan each video as a storyboard of shots in order, with timing, voiceover, overlay and sound.
Name the visual references each shot must match. A reference with no file yet shows as a requirement.
presentation.access: Briefs, storyboards, shots and references live in your organization's Onto. The app adds its record types there once, and every change is a change batch you review in Onto. It does not generate video. Demo data is synthetic and read-only.
